::: {#9783f3ef .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```
:::


@fig-runtime-rating plots each film's runtime against its IMDb rating. 

::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()
```
